Name: CloudSync
Author: FawazT
Description:
[size=6]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Download focustense's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28870]StardewUI[/url]﻿ mod[/*]
[*]Download the main mod and a cloud provider extension[/*]
[*]Optionally, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33653]Global Config Settings Rewrite[/url]﻿﻿ to preserve your settings[/*]
[/list]

[size=6]Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Upload and download your saves from cloud storage services[/*]
[*]Backup your saves when uploading[/*]
[*]Automatically upload your save after sleeping[/*]
[*]Get a warning if an existing save has more progress when uploading or downloading[/*]
[*]Support for adding your own cloud storage service using a [url=https://github.com/FawazTakahji/CloudSync/tree/main/ExampleExtension]custom extension[/url]﻿ mod[/*]
[/list]

[size=6]FAQ[/size]
[size=4]My settings keep getting reset[/size]
When transferring the save between pc and mobile the pc settings will get reset, to solve this issue you should download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33653]Global Config Settings Rewrite[/url] mod and enable the Apply on load option


[size=6]Todo[/size]

[*]Add support for other cloud storage services[/*]
[/list]
